Subject: Redwood Inference — Procurement & PO next steps

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the procurement path.

Call recap (high level):
- Use case: reduce per-token inference cost for high-concurrency customer support LLMs; primary constraints are latency under 200ms p95 and SOC2-aligned controls.
- Expected initial scope: 3 models (chat + embeddings) across prod and staging, 24/7 support for go-live.
- Scale expectation: 150M tokens/month first 6 months; potential dedicated pool later.

Stakeholder map we captured:
- Economic buyer / budget holder: Asha Rao (Finance) — confirmed on call.
- Procurement / vendor ops: Liam O'Connor and procurement@acme-fintech.com — handles onboarding/PO.
- Security / legal: internal security team will want SOC2 artifacts and DPA language; Rishi, I cc'd our security lead for any follow-ups on artifacts.

Open items / asks for Acme:
1) Confirm PO process: preferred PO template, billing contact, and required billing fields (company legal name, remit address, tax IDs).
2) Vendor onboarding: who should we send the vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx to and any additional vendor docs (W9, supplier questionnaire)?
3) Security checklist: are there specific controls beyond SOC2 you need? (e.g., data residency, log retention windows)
4) Timeline: target date for issuing PO and expected go-live window.

Attachments I've included: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW) and vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (pre-filled with our info). I can update the SOW to match any procurement/legal requirements you share.

Proposed next steps:
- Asha / Liam: confirm procurement contact and where to upload the vendor_onboarding_form.
- If possible, can you share Acme's PO template and payment terms (Net30, Net45, etc.)?
- Marissa + Liam: 30-minute call later this week to align on PO fields and timeline.

Thanks — I'll wait for the procurement contact and PO template and will loop in finance and legal as needed.

Best,

Marissa Cole

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few answers from procurement/finance side:

1) Economic buyer: Confirmed — I'm the budget owner and control sign-off for vendor spend at this level.
2) PO process: We use a standard PO workflow. Please send a draft invoice + SOW to procurement@acme-fintech.com. We require the following fields on the invoice: legal entity name (Acme Fintech, Inc.), remit address, EIN, and payment terms (we typically are Net30). Please also include bank wire details for ACH/wire.
3) Vendor onboarding: Liam will coordinate onboarding. He needs the completed vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx, a W9 (or equivalent), and SOC2 Type II report (if available). You can upload the files to our secure procurement folder or send via DocuSign link if needed.
4) Security / legal: Our security team requires SOC2 Type II and DPA with standard security addendum. Also confirm whether any customer data will be stored persistently and if logs are retained longer than 90 days — that will affect legal review.
5) Timeline: If we receive a clean SOW + completed vendor form + W9 by EOD Thu (6/30), procurement can issue a PO by next Wed (7/7). Implementation window we'd target for pilot is 3 weeks after PO (so late July).

I'll ask Liam to confirm where you'd like us to upload the docs and to share our PO template.

Thanks — Asha
Asha Rao
VP Finance, Acme Fintech
